title: Stream Filter Generator
prompt: Write a generator function high_scores(scores, cutoff=80) that yields each score >= cutoff.
hints: Loop over scores with for s in scores:
explanation: Using yield turns high_scores into a lazy generator.
visibleTests:
import types
g = high_scores([70, 85, 92, 60])
assert isinstance(g, types.GeneratorType)
assert list(g) == [85, 92]

title: Predict Exhausted Generator
prompt: Type the exact two lines printed when converting a generator to a list twice.
hints: The first list(gen) consumes all items.
The second list(gen) finds the generator already exhausted.
code:
gen = (x for x in range(3))
print(list(gen))
print(list(gen))

title: yield vs return
solution: yield pauses and saves state; return exits the function.
back: `return` terminates the function permanently; `yield` produces a value and pauses the function's state until the next `next()` call.
